text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered 12 pages to service 'inference-prod-contractors' (urgent) due to spike on /v1/generate error rate. Auto-escalation in progress :rotating_light:
alice: seeing a bunch of pages in my phone, is this supposed to go to contractors?
ben: not normally — the service tag for inference-prod should map to 'sre-inference' team, not contractors.
mari: I'm online, taking 1st responder. can someone paste the pd incident link?
incident-bot: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD123456 — current status: triggered -> notified -> ack escalated to schedule 'contractors-night'
leo: acked (contractor) — I got flooded, but I don't have escalation perms to silence.
sre_micah: ok looks like a routing rule regression from last night's rotation deploy. probable root: schedule-tag rewrite in infra-config that accidentally added '-contractors' fallback.
ben: confirming, I see a PR that changed service_tag_map.yaml on infra-config: 
```
- inference-prod: sre-inference
+ inference-prod: sre-inference, inference-prod-contractors
```
ben: that extra alias causes pd-binding to match contractor schedule.
alice: customers complaining about 503s on hosted inference for a few minutes? any telemetry?
sre_micah: yes, CloudTrace shows elevated 500 spikes on rtx-infer nodes between ~T0+60 and T0+240. probably cascade from unhealthy pool.
mari: immediate mitigation plan: 1) silence the contractor schedule, 2) rebind PD service to correct schedule, 3) roll back tag mapping in infra-config, 4) restore and monitor.
ops-bot: Creating internal incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7890
ben: to rebind service on PD: use pd-cli (run by someone with pd admin). I'll paste commands: 
```
# show current bindings
pd service show --id svc_0A1B2C
# update binding to schedule 'sre-inference'
pd service update --id svc_0A1B2C --escalation-policy ep_777 --escalation-schedule sched_sre_inference
```
ben: I'm not PD-admin, can someone run and confirm?
mari: @alice can you run that? you have admin.
alice: running now...
alice: pd service show returned binding to schedule sched_contractors_night, that's the offender. running update...
alice: update succeeded. new binding -> sched_sre_inference :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Service binding update recorded. Automatic silence suggestion: silence 'contractors-night' schedule for 2h to stop noise.
leo: thanks — pages stopped coming through. switching to monitoring.
sre_micah: next, we should roll back infra-config change to remove alias. ben, can you open a revert PR and trigger deploy?
ben: on it. creating revert now, will run canary deploy to infra-config to avoid full blast.
ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra-config/pull/422 — revert service_tag_map change.
ops-bot: Deploy started for infra-config pr#422 -> canary cluster.
alice: sending customer impact note to status page and CS — short message: "We experienced a brief alert and elevated error rate impacting inference API; service is restored and we are investigating root cause. No customer data was affected." Any objections?
mari: fine, add ETA for full postmortem by EOD.
sre_micah: monitoring: 5xxs trending back to baseline over the last 7 minutes. latency normalized.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD123456 acknowledged by mari. Current assignees: mari, alice, ben.
leo: FYI contractor escalations might have acked some pages; they don't have write access to infra so good we switched binding quickly.
ben: can we add a short-lived guard in deploy pipeline to block adding schedules with 'contractors' in service_tag_map? put a lint rule.
sre_micah: good idea — I'll file a follow-up task INF-7891 and assign to infra-team to implement pre-merge validation.
ops-bot: Created follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7891 (add lint to service_tag_map)
alice: timeline summary for postmortem draft (copy/paste): 
```
T0: incident-bot pagerduty pages fired to inference-prod-contractors (wrong binding)
T0+1m: contractor acked, alerted us
T0+3m: alice rebinds PD service to sched_sre_inference
T0+8m: deploy revert PR opened by ben (canary)
T0+14m: infra-config canary deploy succeeds, full restore
T0+20m: error rate back to baseline, pages stopped
Impact: short (approx 20m) increased 5xxs for inference API; several customer requests failed, no data loss.
Action items: revert PR (done), add pre-merge lint (INF-7891), PD admin runbook update for binding changes, postmortem write-up by EOD.
```
mari: thanks, that timeline is good. @sre_micah please do the postmortem write-up, I'll own customer comms + status update.
sre_micah: will draft. one more note: we should ensure contractor schedules are never in escalation for prod services — adding a policy.
alice: closing action: silence contractors-night schedule for 24h (until we confirm they won't receive prod pages) and revoke any accidental bindings perms.
ops-bot: Silence applied to sched_contractors_night for 24h.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD123456 resolved (status: resolved) — summary recorded on ticket INF-7890. :white_check_mark:
leo: thanks for the quick fix team.
ben: adding retrospective item to next infra sync.
sre_micah: nice work everyone — we'll follow up in the postmortem and close INF-7890 once doc is in Google Drive.
alice: closing thread, moving to postmortem channel once draft is ready. :rocket:
